Name: SpaceCocoon
Notes: A sticky object that grabs the player when they get close, unless they have the Spring or Boo power-ups. The player can use the Star Pointer to sling themselves in any direction.

Obj_arg0.Name: Sling Time
Obj_arg0.Description: The amount of time in frames before the player slows down. Default is 60.

Obj_arg1.Name: Default Length
Obj_arg1.Description: The height of the Sling Pod. Default is 100.

Obj_arg3.Name: Is Toad Attached?
Obj_arg3.Description: Attaches a toad to the object. If the toad is attached, the object sends an SW_A signal upon releasing the Toad.

SW_A.Description: SW_A activates when a Kinopio is released from the object.
